# Google Patents

> A comprehensive global patent database providing access to historical and modern patent records from multiple jurisdictions including Austria, the US, and Europe.

Google Patents aggregates patent information from various patent offices and databases like the USPTO and Espacenet, enabling researchers and inventors to search, browse, and analyze patent families and historical patent records across different countries and filing dates.

## Key Topics

- Austrian patents
- Historical patents
- Patent records
- Patent families
- Patent metadata
- USPTO
- Espacenet
- Patent filing dates
- Patent inventors
- Patent search
- International patents
- Patent documentation

## Historical Austrian Patents

- [AT2085B - Theodor Griesemann (1899)](https://patents.google.com/patent/AT2085B/ro): Austrian patent AT2085B by Theodor Griesemann filed in 1899
- [AT5008B - Wilhelm Dr Ostertag (1900)](https://patents.google.com/patent/AT5008B/de): Austrian patent AT5008B by Wilhelm Dr Ostertag filed in 1900
